body.objective: Lift the certified BT one-, two-, and three-emission ordered coefficients from an unmarked total count into the actual growing family of labeled nested collinear histories, and determine whether they define a positive normalized channel-resolved quantum instrument affiliated at first order with the certified rank-two physical pair operator.
activates: a channel-faithful alternative to the scalar total-count Cox dilation
an exact positive normalized reduced-mode inclusive instrument through three emissions
a sharp test of whether the physical rank-two one-pair Gram extends to nonlinear labeled histories
body.current_gate: Enumerate the labeled rooted-comb histories with three, four, and five outgoing leaves and their canonical one-leaf insertion fibres; extract the per-extension rates from the independently certified one-, two-, and three-count coefficients including history and simplex factors; construct the finite channel-history jump operators tensored with the two physical jet species; verify complete positivity, trace preservation, exact probability normalization, and reproduction of the three leading tree coefficients; then distinguish what is physically affiliated from what still requires nonlinear amplitude phases, an asymptotic Hamiltonian, spacetime localization, and Eq. 19.
body.stop_condition: Land an exact certificate with an independent history enumeration and Markov/Lindblad verifier that either constructs a nonnegative channel-resolved instrument whose first jump Gram is exactly (1/48) I2 and whose first three leading probabilities reproduce the certified BT tree data, or identifies the first exact positivity, normalization, prefix-consistency, or physical-species obstruction. Keep complete S-matrix, all-order, spacetime-Moller, Eq. 19, gravity, and Lorentzian claims fail-closed.
body.forbid: no fixed three-mark process substituted for the growing 3,4,5 labeled history fibres; no total-count Cox moment used as evidence for a channel tensor; no fitted rate without deriving it from certified per-history coefficients and ordered simplexes; no positive reduced-mode instrument called a full BT asymptotic Hamiltonian, unitary S-matrix, complete probability, Eq. 19 theorem, gravitational/BRST lift, or LORENTZIAN-CAUSAL result
body.resource_hint: The k-emission strongly ordered histories are labeled rooted combs on k+2 leaves, equivalently permutations modulo exchange of the first cherry. Insert a new distinguished leaf either into the cherry in two ways or into one of the ordered-tail gaps, producing k+3 children per history. Work only with exact rational rates and sparse history maps; the largest classical carrier through three emissions has 76 histories and does not require another symbolic seven-point tree sum.
